purpose: Record the audited calibration-table pairing for the GK-2A AMI calibration JSON without asserting the deleted 2025 FD inputs used this table or SRF version.

legacy_json_archive.meaning: Byte-exact copy of the pre-update JSON; channel_center_wavelength and all previous coefficient values are preserved in the updated JSON.

calibration_source.authority: Korea Meteorological Administration, GK-2A AMI Calibration Table v3.0 (20190415)
calibration_source.physical_constants_cells: S18:S20 (light speed, Planck constant, Boltzmann constant)

retained_fd_metadata_check.scope: This distinct 2023 IR087 file has coefficient metadata consistent with v3.0. It does not establish the calibration or SRF version of the deleted 2025 FD files.

history_and_limits.initial_json_commit: d0e4ba3 added the table extracted from 2025-07-19 FD originals and noted those downloads were deleted after extraction; no extractor script or raw-file hashes were retained in that commit.
history_and_limits.later_json_commit: 27cfef1 removed null valid-bit placeholder fields; it did not change calibration coefficients.
history_and_limits.v3_1_note: The current IR133 coefficients match v3.0. KMA v3.1 changes the IR133 SRF-related row, so v3.1 coefficients were not substituted.
not_established: The exact 2025 FD input files or their hashes.
The calibration-table version or SRF version used by those deleted 2025 files.
That all retained or historical AMI files use the same calibration/SRF pairing.
